news.title: Western Union, Visa, PayPal, Meta: why major payments giants are racing to Solana

He makes the case for why Solana has quietly become the dominant chain for institutional payments, tokenized equities, and real world assets. Plus, why he thinks most altcoins are bleeding out, Ethereum L2s are in trouble, and why this bear market might be the best investing opportunity in crypto right now.
